verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API with non-expiring workspace API keys and an MCP server for reading meeting notes. These are programmatic data-access surfaces, which belong to a separate API/MCP story. Nothing documents running Granola itself headlessly or in a CI pipeline, such as a CLI, headless mode, or server-side capture without the desktop or mobile app. The pack cites no OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404s), and recording and note generation are described only as desktop and mobile app flows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
